title: Your account
mailIntro: Choose which e-mails you want. Changes apply at once, and the same choices are behind the link at the bottom of every e-mail.
mailLoadErrorTitle: Your e-mail choices couldn't be loaded
mailLoadErrorText: Reload the page in a while. The choices you made earlier still apply.
languageIntro: The language of the pages and of e-mails to you. The change applies at once. Meeting documents in Google Docs are still written in Swedish.
languageSaveFailed: The language couldn't be saved on your account. It applies in this browser. Try again later.
orgsText: People lists, invite links and transcription settings are under each association.
privacyText: Meeting documents live in Google Drive (the association's meeting folder or the starter's Drive) and are never deleted by us. Transcripts and notes stored with us are deleted when you delete the meeting or the association. Read more in the <link>privacy information</link>.
